description: A mixer of four sources at the corners of a square. Dragging a point in the square sets how much of each corner is heard, and a keyframe animator replays recorded positions

params.text: Scales the voltage arriving at the X POSITION input
Scales the voltage arriving at the Y POSITION input
Scales the voltage arriving at the AZIMUTH input
Shifts the angle of the point around the square
Scales the voltage arriving at the MAGNITUDE input
Shifts how far the point is placed from the centre of the square
Stores the position showing now as a new keyframe
Deletes the keyframe playback is on
Plays the stored keyframes back, moving the point through them
Holds playback where it is, and carries on from there when pressed again
Takes playback back to the first keyframe
Makes playback start again from the first keyframe once it reaches the last
Records a keyframe continuously as the position is moved
Makes the X and Y outputs unipolar
Multiplies the X and Y outputs by ten

inputs.text: One of the two inputs for the source at that corner
A voltage setting the horizontal position
A voltage setting the vertical position
A voltage setting the angle of the point around the square
A voltage setting how far the point is placed from the centre of the square
A pulse stores the position showing now as a new keyframe
A pulse starts playback of the stored keyframes
A pulse holds playback where it is, or carries on from there
A pulse takes playback back to the first keyframe
A pulse switches continuous keyframe recording on and off

outputs.text: One of the two main outputs, carrying the mix at the position showing in the square
The horizontal position in the square as a voltage
The vertical position in the square as a voltage
A gate while the square is being dragged, for use as a controller

notes: the keyframe animator plays nothing until positions have been stored in it: store them one at a time, or switch on continuous recording and drag the point around the square.
X and Y take precedence over the angle and distance settings, which take precedence over dragging the point.
every corner input works on polyphonic cables, and the output takes the channel count of whichever corner carries the most channels.
menu: X-Y modes (inputs + animator) — settles what happens when the position inputs and the keyframe animator both act
PRIORITY to the X-Y POSITIONS inputs — with MIX X-Y POSITIONS inputs with KF ANIMATOR if running and PRIORITY to the KF ANIMATOR if running, the three choices under X-Y modes
Use input range -5V to +5V (normally 0V to 10V) — moves the position inputs off their 0-10V range
Trails — switches the drawing of the path the point has taken through the square
Lowpass output — puts a low pass filter on the mixed output
